## Problem

What are you trying to do that Raven doesn't support (or makes harder than it
should be)?

## Proposal

A concrete proposal for how Raven could address it. Command sketches,
flag names, schema examples, or query syntax are all helpful.

Note that Raven aims to provide general-purpose knowledge-management
primitives (types, traits, references, queries) rather than
workflow-specific tools, and avoids implicit "magic" behavior. Proposals
framed in those terms are easier to evaluate.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the problem, including workarounds you're using today.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps explain the request.
